article.headline: Butler earns 78-39 win against Merrimack
article.description: — Pierre Brooks scored 23 points as Butler beat Merrimack 78-39 on Friday night.
article.story: INDIANAPOLIS -- — Pierre Brooks scored 23 points as Butler beat Merrimack 78-39 on Friday night. Brooks added 12 rebounds for the Bulldogs (4-1). Andre Screen scored 12 points while finishing 5 of 6 from the floor and added nine rebounds. Patrick McCaffery had 11 points and shot 3 of 8 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 4 from the line. Adam Clark led the way for the Warriors (1-4) with eight points and four assists. Butler led 37-31 at halftime, with Brooks racking up 15 points. Butler extended its lead to 65-33 during the second half, fueled by a 28-2 scoring run. Brooks scored a team-high eight points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
